subject.title: refactor(config): retire flat and scalar streaming keys from matrix, feishu, and qqbot

question: Should this protected, upgrade-sensitive PR require live fresh-install and legacy-upgrade proof for Matrix, Feishu, and QQBot, or receive an explicit proof override based on its Testbox and migration-test evidence?
rationale: The implementation appears internally coherent, but tests and delivery goldens cannot prove that real released config files are repaired, accepted at startup, and behaviorally equivalent across three channel plugins.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or linked artifact showing old config, `openclaw doctor --fix`, successful restart, and equivalent streaming behavior for each channel before merge.

options.title: Apply a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the Testbox suites, migration tables, and unchanged delivery goldens as sufficient for this maintainer-led release-train refactor.

recommendation.title: Require live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal or linked artifact showing old config, `openclaw doctor --fix`, successful restart, and equivalent streaming behavior for each channel before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the merged migration sequence, shared DSL, and prior compatibility decision that this PR extends.
